notes: Reading thereabout as noncompositional under rule 45 remains defensible, but rule 81's test is met: there- answers to τούτου and -about to περί.
The apodotic καί is left unrepresented on rule 65's English-side test; LUK.24.15 writes that for the same construction, which is one analysis applied to two surfaces under rule 24, not two analyses.
